scripts.ios:sync: pnpm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build: pnpm run ios:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.android:sync: pnpm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: pnpm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
